قُرَابَةٌ : see قُرْبٌ, first quarter: ―
-b2- and قِرَابٌ, in two places: and قَرِيبٌ, near the end, in three places. ―
-b3- قُرَابَةُ المُؤْمِنِ and ↓ قُرَابُهُ signify The believer's فِرَاسَة [i. e. insight, or intuitive perception, &c.]; (Fr, O, K;) and his opinion, which is near to knowledge and assurance: occurring in a trad., in which it is said that one is to beware thereof, because he looks with the light of God. (Fr, O, TA. [See also فِرَاسَةٌ.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
